decision.reason: The only evidence is a short changelog line under "Enhancements": "Semconv OTLP stable HTTP metrics" [ev-983fcb0d825d]. It doesn't say whether existing OTLP HTTP metric names or attributes changed (behavior-changed) or whether a new set of metrics or an option was added (added). It also doesn't say what the concrete subject is, such as a metric name, a config key or wire behaviour. To decide the subject and change type, we need the content of PR #10421 or the v3 metrics or migration docs listing the metric names and attributes before and after.
